canggu.title: Private wellness around life in Canggu
canggu.body: A Canggu stay often has several activities competing for the same morning: breakfast, a beach visit, school routines or time at the laptop. Private wellness works best when the visit fits that existing rhythm. Berawa, Batu Bolong, Pererenan and Echo Beach addresses can have very different access, even within the same broad cluster. A shaded floor and an indoor weather alternative make repeat visits easier to coordinate.

canggu.title: Choose the visit that fits the space
canggu.body: Personal training, private yoga, mat Pilates and mobility each use a property differently. Yoga needs room for the chosen mats and props; a resistance workout depends on the equipment agreed; a mat class needs enough clearance for controlled movements. Massage requires a private appointment setting and the appropriate equipment. Name the service rather than asking for a general wellness hour. Your coordinator can then check the right professional and setup for Canggu. The wider catalogue is available to enquire about, but not every format is guaranteed at every address or time.

canggu.title: A weekly schedule for your household
canggu.body: A family might choose yoga for two on Tuesday and personal training for one person on Friday. Another household may prefer three regular fitness visits each week. The schedule can record who attends each appointment instead of assuming the whole family joins everything. Start with one paid visit if you want to experience the approach first. When ready, agree a two, three or four-week block and prepay the named visits. A monthly plan is four weeks, with dates, a participant count and a validity window stated on the quote.

canggu.title: Prices and travel in Canggu
canggu.body: For published core services, Canggu and Seminyak include in-zone travel. Ubud and Sanur add Rp 150.000 per visit, while Uluwatu adds Rp 200.000. Starting reference rates for core services are shown on the pricing page. Extra people, a longer session, a different format or specialist equipment can change the total. Eligible fitness blocks receive the published 5%, 8% or 12% savings at six, nine or twelve qualifying visits. Travel and external costs are not reduced by that saving. Your final quote confirms the complete payable amount before you accept.

east-jakarta.body: East Jakarta requests are considered by neighbourhood and professional capacity. A regular family routine may be possible when the professional can reach the property at the required time, but it is not assumed from the city label. east-jakarta.body: Personal training, private yoga, mat Pilates and mobility each use a property differently. Yoga needs room for the chosen mats and props; a resistance workout depends on the equipment agreed; a mat class needs enough clearance for controlled movements. Massage requires a private appointment setting and the appropriate equipment. Name the service rather than asking for a general wellness hour. Your coordinator can then check the right professional and setup for East Jakarta. The wider catalogue is available to enquire about, but not every format is guaranteed at every address or time.

east-jakarta.body: A family might choose yoga for two on Tuesday and personal training for one person on Friday. Another household may prefer three regular fitness visits each week. The schedule can record who attends each appointment instead of assuming the whole family joins everything. Start with one paid visit if you want to experience the approach first. When ready, agree a two, three or four-week block and prepay the named visits. A monthly plan is four weeks, with dates, a participant count and a validity window stated on the quote.

east-jakarta.title: Prices and travel in East Jakarta
east-jakarta.body: Availability and travel are quoted for your exact East Jakarta address. A zero travel figure is not assumed, and an enquiry does not establish that the requested service can be delivered there. Starting reference rates for core services are shown on the pricing page. Extra people, a longer session, a different format or specialist equipment can change the total. Eligible fitness blocks receive the published 5%, 8% or 12% savings at six, nine or twelve qualifying visits. Travel and external costs are not reduced by that saving. Your final quote confirms the complete payable amount before you accept.

east-jakarta.title: A personal brief that keeps visits connected
east-jakarta.body: For a managed plan, you can agree a wellness brief covering practical preferences, the pace you like and what you want to repeat.
